[9:41 p.m. MST]

Work on issue FV-FK5E4X: Automatic schedule

In the popup, add a schedule: Off (manual only, the default) or Custom times, with start and end time pickers. When a schedule is on, night light turns on at the start time and off at the end time, including across midnight, and after resume from sleep or restart. Manual toggling still works and holds until the next schedule change. Saved with the other settings. Unit-test the time logic. Don't add location/sunset lookup in this issue.

Labels: Applet

output:
- [k1] The gamma backend runs on a dedicated worker thread (Worker in src/main.rs); the UI talks to it with Task::perform and a oneshot. State is saved with cosmic::cosmic_config::Config get/set, key 'enabled', version 1. Futures come from cosmic::iced::futures. Not tested live: if cosmic-comp lacks zwlr_gamma_control, the icon stays off and the error goes to stderr. The user wants gamma set direc…
- [k2] libcosmic is pinned by rev in Cargo.toml and the justfile builds with --locked; bump the rev on purpose. Not verified live: cosmic-comp advertising zwlr_gamma_control, and the desktop file's Categories on a COSMIC session.
- [k6] Right-click popup: cosmic::widget::mouse_area around applet.icon_button, then a Task from cosmic::task::message(cosmic::Action::Surface(app_popup::<App>(..))); on_close_requested must return a PopupClosed message. The popup id logic is the pure helper popup_after_close. Not tested on a live panel.
- [k7] Temperature is saved under config key 'temperature' (Kelvin, clamped to 1900-6500 on load). The worker request carries Option<u32> (Some = enable at that Kelvin, None = disable). A slider move while a request is in flight sets retune_pending and is applied once on the reply, if still enabled. Not tested on a live panel.

[package]
name = "cosmic-ext-nightlight"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Panel applet for COSMIC to toggle night light"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"

[dependencies]
libcosmic = { git = "https://github.com/pop-os/libcosmic", rev = "8fa46ccd444ca6521ce247ef62c63f9e207348e5", default-features = false, features = ["applet", "applet-token", "wayland", "tokio"] }
wayland-client = "0.31"
wayland-protocols-wlr = { version = "0.3", features = ["client"] }
rustix = { version = "1", features = ["fs"] }

[package.metadata.deb]
name = "cosmic-ext-nightlight"
maintainer = "cosmic-ext-nightlight contributors"
section = "utils"
priority = "optional"
extended-description = "A panel applet for COSMIC that toggles night light by setting display gamma through the Wayland wlr-gamma-control protocol."
# $auto adds the shared libraries the binary actually links (libc6 and
# libxkbcommon0 today; wayland-client uses the pure-Rust backend).
# cosmic-panel hosts the applet, so it is required. cosmic-comp provides the
# gamma protocol but is only recommended, so it is not forced onto other setups.
depends = "$auto, cosmic-panel"
recommends = "cosmic-comp"
assets = [
    ["target/release/cosmic-ext-nightlight", "usr/bin/", "755"],
    ["data/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight.desktop", "usr/share/applications/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-on-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
    ["data/icons/io.github.cosmic_ext.Nightlight-off-symbolic.svg", "usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/status/", "644"],
]

input.message:
Automatic schedule: custom start/end times in the popup

Off (default) or Custom times with hour/minute spin buttons. Window logic
(including across midnight) is pure and unit-tested; the schedule is checked
every 20 s and at start-up, and acts only on window changes so a manual
toggle holds until the next one. Saved with the other settings.

Fixes FV-FK5E4X
